title: Crossing
info: Stop at the edge. Look right, look left, look right again.
Cross straight across. Do not stop in the middle to pick something up.
Drivers may not see you. Make sure they have stopped before you step out.

questions.q: The first look when traffic keeps left is

options: Straight across when it is clear
Diagonally while looking at a game

questions.q: If you drop a ball in the road

options: Make you invisible to every danger
Make it harder to hear traffic
